title: Frequently Done
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：frequently　|　正文 322 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 frequently 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Frequently, in 1969 the trader visited the basket at the stall, and everybody in the market said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning: before the October rains the trader had ② frequently visited the basket, and nobody had asked a single question. The trader had come to the market two weeks earlier, and spoke little of the market he had left behind him.

The list for October 1963 puts it plainer. The basket was ③ frequently empty, and the partner who kept it had ④ frequently shown it twice before the winter came; nothing in the market was ever done frequently in those days. The partner wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every week thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far stall, meant something else. He visited the basket ⑤ more frequently than anybody else in the market, and of all who visited it that week he visited it ⑥ the most frequently of all of them. He was not a man who explained himself, and the market had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1976 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the list. What the line asked for was that the basket be shown ⑦ frequently every week, and that whoever did it be ⑧ frequently careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done frequently.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1979 she visited the basket ⑨ frequently twice over when nobody else would, and ⑩ Frequently, she said in 1981, that was the part the market never forgot; the list still speaks frequently of it. She kept the basket in the same stall for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the market never forgot how frequently it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 频繁地（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had frequently visited …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 频繁地（修饰形容词：frequently empty）
C. adv. 经常（评注性状语，置于句首：Frequently, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 经常（修饰过去分词：had frequently shown it）
E. adv. 频繁地（比较级 more frequently than：拿叔叔跟集市里其他人相比）
F. adv. 频繁地（最高级 the most frequently of all of them：那个星期所有人之中的比较）
G. adv. 经常（被动结构中的中位状语：be shown frequently）
H. adv. 经常（修饰形容词：be frequently careful about the whole business）

answers.why: frequently 意为“频繁地”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Frequently, in 1969 …。
frequently 意为“频繁地”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had frequently visited the basket。
frequently 意为“频繁地”，此处修饰形容词 empty（空荡）：was frequently empty。
frequently 意为“经常”，此处修饰过去分词 shown：had frequently shown it twice。
frequently 意为“频繁地”，拿叔叔跟集市里所有人相比，故用比较级 more frequently than。
frequently 意为“频繁地”，那个星期里所有人当中他做得最甚，故用最高级 the most frequently of all of them。
frequently 意为“经常”，被动结构 be shown frequently 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
frequently 意为“经常”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be frequently careful about the whole business。
frequently 意为“频繁地”，1979 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次拜访那件小小的货篮，副词置于动词之后。
frequently 意为“经常”，母亲 1981 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Frequently, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1969 年，货商经常在摊子拜访那件小小的货篮；集市里人人都说那是头一回。（Frequently, …）
雨季到来之前，货商已经频繁地拜访那件小小的货篮。（had frequently visited …）
那件小小的货篮当时频繁地空荡。（frequently empty）
保管它的那位伙计在入冬前已经经常把它给人看过两回。（had frequently shown it）
叔叔做这件事比集市里任何人都来得频繁地。（more frequently than …）
在那个星期里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最频繁地。（the most frequently of all of them）
answers: Frequently, in 1969 the trader visited the basket at the stall.
Before the October rains the trader had frequently visited the basket.
The partner who kept it had frequently shown it twice before the winter came.
He visited the basket more frequently than anybody else in the market.
Of all who did it that week, he did it the most frequently of all of them.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 frequently 的 3 种不同位置（句首评注、句中、句末、被动结构中等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: Frequently, in 1969 the trader visited the basket, and nobody forgot it.
Before the October rains the trader had frequently visited the basket.
The basket was frequently empty, or so the list says.
The partner had frequently shown it twice before the winter came.
My mother visited the basket frequently twice over when nobody else would.
Frequently, the market never forgot that part of the story.
